news.title: BSE MidCap Select Index - Business Today

guidance: But I want to know as we are running on the high base from FY26, do we expect any smoothing of growth going forward into FY27?
While the exceptional quarter on Q4 driven by many other factors holds the last year's numbers, we expect the numbers this year to be on a strong momentum as well.
capex: And when I say a year, I'm talking of maybe four quarters back, a billion transactions a day, and we've already handled more than 3 billion transactions a day with the capacity to handle more than double that.
risks: Forward -looking statements by their nature address matters that are, to different degrees, uncertain.
These uncertainties may cau se our actual results to be materially different that those expressed in our forward -looking statements.
focus: This demonstrates the scalability of our business model and continued focus on efficiency.
So, what are our new products, let's say, for example, index options that you were trying to scale?
We have a strong feedback from market because any new product introduced also, we need to be really sure that despite having done the work, all the approvals that the product meets purpose.
